name: Superhuman Mail
description: Superhuman Mail is an AI email and calendar client for Gmail and Microsoft 365 with Split Inboxes, threads, drafts, scheduling, personalization, and a hosted remote MCP server.
agentUseSummary: Superhuman Mail cannot currently be connected through Relay because its official integration is a broad provider-hosted remote MCP server requiring a new OAuth discovery, dynamic-client-registration, PKCE, token, account-binding, and tool-schema foundation. Its advertised OAuth scopes are identity/refresh scopes rather than granular Mail authority, while the MCP can read sensitive email/calendar data and perform immediate mutations.

blocked.label: Connect the hosted MCP server
blocked.description: Relay has not approved or implemented the generic remote-MCP OAuth discovery, DCR, S256 PKCE, callback, refresh, issuer/account binding, and schema-pinning foundation this provider requires.

blocked.label: Relabel identity scopes as Mail scopes
blocked.description: Discovered openid/profile/email/offline_access scopes establish identity and refresh behavior but do not define granular read, draft, send, delete, calendar, or personalization authority.

blocked.label: Expose raw MCP tools
blocked.description: Dynamic tool discovery, arbitrary MCP calls, silent schema additions, broad semantic search, and unpinned raw tool output are not permitted.

blocked.label: Access Superhuman Mail data
blocked.description: Accounts, Split Inboxes, labels, email/calendar search, messages, threads, attachments, read receipts, drafts, sends, events, availability, trash, unsubscribe, thread state, personalization, and every read or write remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Alias another mail product
blocked.description: Gmail, Outlook, and Superhuman Docs/Coda are separate provider products and cannot substitute for Superhuman Mail's native semantics.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until Relay approves the remote-MCP trust model and pins a narrow Superhuman-native wrapper contract.

runtimeSupport.description: The hosted Superhuman MCP server is not mounted through Relay's unapproved remote-MCP foundation.

providerSetup.blocker: Superhuman provides a real hosted MCP server with broad mail/calendar read-write tools, but Relay has no approved generic remote-MCP OAuth/DCR/schema-pinning product and the advertised identity scopes do not constrain Mail authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not show Connect or mount the raw server. Reconsider after explicit architecture/security approval of remote MCP, proof of persistent provider read-only enforcement, pinned reviewed tool schemas, issuer/account binding, refresh/disconnect handling, and external-AI data governance.

evidence.supports: Superhuman documents a hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server with browser authorization for arbitrary MCP clients, Business-plan requirements, and possible Enterprise admin enablement.
The hosted MCP resource advertises a separate Superhuman authorization server through standards discovery.
The authorization server advertises authorization-code, refresh, device, dynamic-registration, S256 PKCE, and identity/offline scopes rather than granular Mail action scopes.
The MCP tool surface includes sensitive reads and immediate draft/send, calendar, trash, unsubscribe, account, personalization, and thread-state mutations, with no MCP-specific audit marker.
